findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: format_screenplay, check_credits · Private data: build_video_prompts, check_video_prompts, get_film_contract, compile_film_breakdown, render_story_handoff · Public sink: format_screenplay, analyze_screenplay, render_bilingual_pdf, check_video_prompts · Destructive: format_screenplay, analyze_screenplay, convert_fountain, check_video_prompts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: format_screenplay, check_credits · Private data: build_video_prompts, check_video_prompts, get_film_contract, compile_film_breakdown, render_story_handoff · Public sink: format_screenplay, analyze_screenplay, render_bilingual_pdf, check_video_prompts · Destructive: format_screenplay, analyze_screenplay, convert_fountain, check_video_prompts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
